name: SILL Entreprises
note: Breton family agri-food federation (SIREN 636220220, SAS, Le Raden, Plouvien, capital EUR 18,830,562.30, RCS Brest 636 220 220) founded in 1962 by two families of butter merchants, Falc'hun and León, and still run by them: Sebastien Floch is Président de SAS, with Tristan Falc'hun and Henri León as Directeurs Généraux. No state or fund stake found.
